name: portfolio
description: Single-file portfolio page for the CV in `../resume.md`, with all identifying details removed (name, contacts, account handles, university names, publications). The background is a pod of orcas rendered as square dots — a particle simulation written in Rust, compiled to `wasm32-unknown-unknown` with [wasm-bindgen](https://github.com/wasm-bindgen/wasm-bindgen), and embedded into the page as base64 (works from `file://`, no server needed).
